transcript.text: Good morning. Before I issue today's vehicle assignments and dispatch board, I need all representatives to report any load or vehicle-control requirements per our standard transport-board huddle. We have four moves on the board: clinic cold-storage cases to the medical annex, a communications mast to the north relay point, a generator to the engineering yard, and routine administrative pallets to the headquarters warehouse. Our available vehicles are the refrigerated van RV-2, flatbed F-7, 5-ton truck T-5, and 2.5-ton truck T-2 — one vehicle per move. Transportation, medical, signal, and engineer reps, please report your requirements now so I can assign the right vehicle to each move.
